title: The Witness Who Was Never Called

scenes.text: A 1974 warehouse fire took four lives. The file closed with one witness never called.
scenes.art_prompt: a rain-soaked city street at night in the 1970s, wet asphalt, lone streetlight

scenes.text: Her statement sat in the folder for fifty years. It was never signed.
scenes.art_prompt: a cluttered detective's desk, photographs and folders under a green desk lamp

scenes.text: The arson investigator retired. The case went cold. The folder went to the archive.
scenes.art_prompt: an old archive room lined with dusty files, narrow aisle, single bulb

scenes.text: A researcher pulled the folder last spring and read the statement to the end.
scenes.art_prompt: faded carbon-copy pages spread on a table, typewritten, one line underlined

scenes.text:
The witness described the fire from inside the building.
The name on the statement was the investigator's own.
scenes.art_prompt: a faded photograph on a mantelpiece, one face scratched out, cold light
an empty car parked on a remote road at dusk, doors closed, unexplained
